answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the sparrow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the meadow of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
